settings.heading: What does integrated compliance mean?
settings.text: It means coordinating policy, responsibilities, testing controls, training, records and review within one operating model. The aim is to close the gaps between separate activities, not simply bundle several products together.

settings.heading: How is this different from a Managed Compliance Program?
settings.text: Integrated Compliance focuses on how multiple fitness-for-work controls connect across your organisation. A Managed Compliance Program is the better starting point when your main need is ongoing coordination and maintenance of a drug and alcohol testing program.

settings.heading: Which control areas can be included?
settings.text: The proposed framework brings alcohol, drugs, fatigue and broader fitness-for-work governance into one view. The final scope, including which services Andatech provides directly, coordinates or refers, would be confirmed during discovery.

settings.heading: Can we keep our existing policies, devices and systems?
settings.text: Potentially. The first step is to map what already exists, identify where controls disconnect and determine what can be retained, improved or replaced. An integrated model should respond to your operating reality rather than force an unnecessary rebuild.

settings.heading: Does Andatech take responsibility for our workplace policy?
settings.text: No. Your organisation retains responsibility for legal advice, consultation, policy approval, employment decisions, privacy and workplace risk. Andatech's role would be defined around agreed program enablement, technology, training, reporting and review support.

settings.heading: How does Andalink fit into the program?
settings.text: Andalink is positioned as the reporting and evidence layer. Depending on the confirmed scope, it may connect testing activity, device and calibration status, training records and program actions without replacing the policy and operational controls behind them.

settings.heading: What happens in the first conversation?
settings.text: We start with your sites, roles, policies, current testing methods, systems and known gaps. That conversation establishes whether Integrated Compliance, a Managed Compliance Program or an individual solution is the most appropriate pathway.
